draft.title: Volcanism
card: Volcanism is the rising of melted rock from inside the Earth. Below the surface this melted rock is called magma. Once it erupts onto the surface it is called lava.
Magma rises through cracks and weak spots in the crust. A volcano forms where it breaks through and erupts lava, ash and gas.
Each eruption adds new material to the surface. Layers of lava and ash can pile up into a steep cone, such as Mount Fuji in Japan.
Very runny lava can spread out over a wide area before it sets. Over many eruptions this can build a flat, raised plateau.
draft.remember: Volcanoes build land: magma rises, erupts, and the lava and ash pile up into new landforms.

a.q: What is the main way that volcanism changes the land surface?
opts: It adds new material as lava and ash settle and build up
It wears rock away and carries the pieces to a new place
It squeezes layers of rock into waves without any eruption
It breaks rock down where it sits using frost and heat
a.why: Eruptions bring melted rock and ash up from inside the Earth, and this material builds new landforms. Wearing rock away and carrying it is a different process, which is why that option is wrong.
a.clue: Think about what comes out of a volcano when it erupts.

b.q: A volcano erupts again and again, and each time ash and lava settle around the vent. What landform is most likely to build up?
opts: A steep cone around the vent
A deep valley cut by a river
A long beach of sand and shells
A tall sea stack beside a cliff
b.why: Layers of ash and lava landing around the vent pile up over time and form a cone. A valley, beach and stack are made by water and waves wearing rock away or dropping pieces, not by eruptions.
b.clue: Where does the erupted material land, and what happens as it piles up?

a.best: It adds new material as lava and ash settle and build up

b.best: A steep cone around the vent

problems.detail: The stem says ash and lava settle 'around the vent', and only the right option repeats 'around the vent', so a student could match the words without knowing the idea. Consider rewording the stem, or adding a location detail to the distractors.
